question: In long jump, the take-off has to be made from a _______ cm wide board one meter away from a pit.
solution:
The correct answer is __**20 cm**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The take-off board in long jump must be **20 cm** wide.
 
• This board is positioned **one meter** away from the sand pit where the jumpers land.
 
• The take-off board is a crucial element in long jump as it ensures that athletes have a consistent point from which they can launch their jump.
 
• Proper measurement and placement of the take-off board are essential for the fairness and accuracy of the competition.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The long jump is an event in which athletes combine speed, strength, and agility in an attempt to leap as far as possible from a take-off point.
 
• In official competitions, athletes have a limited number of attempts to achieve their best possible distance.
 
• The distance of the jump is measured from the take-off line to the nearest mark made in the sand pit by any part of the athlete's body.
 
• Ensuring a proper take-off technique is crucial for maximizing the jump distance and ensuring the athlete's safety.
